name: SettingsSections
description: The rail + pane body of a settings dialog. Usable inside any Dialog.Popup.
signature: ({ sections, section, defaultSection, onSectionChange, label, keepMounted }: SettingsSectionsProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep every section mounted (hidden when not current), so one form spans them all.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: onSectionChange
props.description: Called when section change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.
